name: identities-v1 P-037 orchestrator typecheck (source-kind contracts, D-131 freeze)
summary: Full, non-incremental tsc --noEmit over the orchestrator package project after the D-132/D-133 peer source window and the composition-packages control-fixture typing correction. The project's include is src/**/*.ts, covering the P-037 sources and tests. tsc printed zero diagnostics and exited 0. The same-project --listFilesOnly census at 19:39 contained 207 orchestrator src files. The earlier 19:39 typecheck failed TS2769/TS2339 at composition-packages.test.ts:304; WI-10003339 narrowed the overloaded test callable, and this run verifies that correction. This measures the working tree, including that then-uncommitted test correction.

assertions.evidence: npx tsc --noEmit --incremental false -p libs/papercusp/packages/orchestrator/tsconfig.json exited 0 at 19:45:24Z and emitted no diagnostics. The shell preserved tsc's exit status explicitly.

tsc --listFilesOnly over the same project lists 207 files under packages/orchestrator/src/, including src/blueprint/loader.ts, composition-compiler.ts and stack-mutation.ts, and the tests src/blueprint/contracts.test.ts, loader.layers.test.ts and loader.test.ts. tsconfig include = src/**/*.ts, bin/**/*.ts and the vitest configs, so blueprint/schema.ts (imported by contracts.test.ts) is also type-checked.

The compiler source and sibling test were re-frozen under 1c1a2fa8-cbb6-44a1-b93a-25224f100ef1 after the peer window; the remaining D-131 subjects retain 7400f4ff-83f4-469b-8281-1f361c40b6bc and 57ebf67f-2bb8-4229-b9ca-9ed555613407. At run time only composition-packages.test.ts was dirty in the orchestrator package. Its corrected blob 2708e44e85fb9514b67fcf0c200e9ae35055b0ef subsequently committed in 6be1d812cf3fc0be26e77b5cf7f62f0ed553622f; the package status was clean at the 19:47 verification.
